policy.meaning: A receipt records an explicit comparison of one canonical statement or typed relation against its cited Lean signatures and public claim boundary.
policy.digest_binding: The digest covers the subject wording, evidence coordinates, formal-source revision, and declaration-atlas source fingerprint.

reviewer_types.ai_semantic_consistency_review: A Type A model checked the authored meaning against exact public source signatures and status boundaries. This is not independent human mathematical review.
reviewer_types.human_mathematical_review: A named human reviewer checked the mathematical informalisation and relation.

non_claims: A receipt is not Lean proof authority.
A receipt is not a novelty or prior-art judgement.
A model review is not represented as human mathematical review.
Unreceipted nodes remain authored navigation, not reviewed semantic fidelity.
A rebinding is not a re-review; it records that the atlas pin moved while the reviewed material did not.
policy.rebinding: The digest covers the declaration-atlas source fingerprint, which fingerprints the whole Lean tree, so adding an unrelated module makes every receipt stale without any reviewed statement having changed. python3 scripts/semantic_review.py --rebind moves that pin, and only that pin: it recomputes a digest solely when the reviewed wording, evidence coordinates, boundary, and pinned formal-source revision are byte-identical, and refuses by name otherwise. Each rebound receipt keeps its superseded digest and fingerprint under evidence_rebindings.
